indicator_name: Statutory tax and contribution rates: VAT, corporate and personal income tax, social tax, social and pension contributions, medical insurance, mineral extraction tax on metals, excises, export duty on crude oil, monthly
description: Законодательные ставки налогов и обязательных взносов: НДС, КПН, ИПН, социальный налог, социальные отчисления, пенсионные взносы, ОСМС, НДПИ на металлы, акцизы, вывозная пошлина на нефть, помесячно
unit: % (excises: KZT per tonne or per 1 000 sticks; oil export duty: USD per tonne) -- see item_name
methodology: Hand-kept (config/tax_rates.yaml): the rate in force in each month, read in the text of the act that set it (acts and articles are listed in the file; the three research notes with URLs and quotes are docs/research_tax_*_2026-11-13.md). Current editions were read on zakon.uchet.kz (mirror of adilet.zan.kz), earlier editions on prg.kz (a commercial database with dated editions), customs and excise resolutions on alta.ru. A month is ABSENT only when there was no single rate: gold and uranium MET from 2026 (scales by price and output), diesel excise 2016-10..2022-03 (seasonal 9 300 / 540), petrol and diesel excise from 2025-05 (38 134 and 35 726 became a base plus 50 %, from September 2026 95 %, of the wholesale price above a threshold), oil export duty from March 2016 (a table by price; from September 2023 USD/t equal to the price in USD/bbl for 25-105). VAT 20 from 1995-07, 16 from 2001-07, 15 from 2004, 14 from 2007, 13 from 2008, 12 from 2009, 16 from 2026-01. CIT 30 from 1995-07, 20 from 2009 (17.5 and 15 were legislated for 2010-2011 and never applied). PIT and PIT_TOP are the lowest and the highest bracket: 5 and 30 in 2002-2003, 5 and 20 in 2004-2006, flat 10 in 2007-2025, 10 and 15 (above 8 500 MRP a year) from 2026. SOCIAL_TAX: 21 flat to 2003, first bracket of a regressive scale in 2004-2007 (20) and 2008 (13), flat 11 from 2009, 9.5 from 2018, 11 from 2025, 6 from 2026 -- BUT until 2025 the amount payable was the tax minus social contributions (net 6 in 2018-2025), and the 2025 Code has no offset, so 6 in 2026 is not a cut. MET_URANIUM keeps 22 for 2009-2012, the rate in force then; Law 61-V of 2012 retroactively set 17.5 for those years; from 2023 the base differs. MET_OIL_TOP is the top step of the oil scale (18 in 2009-2026, domestic sales x 0.5). OIL_EXPORT_DUTY_RATE: a change inside a month is dated to the month it applied for most of; 139.79 USD/t applied for about a week in January 2009 and is not in the series. Not here: rent tax on export, reduced VAT rates (medicines 5 in 2026), special regimes, import excises. Налоговые кодексы 2001, 2008, 2017 и 2025 гг., законы о внесении изменений, Социальный кодекс, закон об ОСМС, постановления Правительства и приказы о ставках акцизов и вывозных пошлин; тексты по zakon.uchet.kz (зеркало adilet.zan.kz), ранние редакции по prg.kz, акты о пошлинах и акцизах по alta.ru; сверено 2026-11-13.
